in_sanskrit.meaning: to crush, to destroy, to devastate

in_hindi.name: परशु
in_hindi.long_meaning: पहला शोधनात्मक चित्त, जिसका कारण उठाना और नष्ट करना साथ है

in_marathi.name: Parashu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ax in hand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parashu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parashu is the name of a weapon, specifically a battle ax. In Hindu mythology, Parashu Rama is the name of a hero who wielded this weapon. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'parash' meaning 'great' and 'shu' meaning 'ax'.

in_bengali.name: Parashu

In Hindu mythology, Parashu Rama is the name of a hero who wielded this weapon. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'parash' meaning 'great' and 'shu' meaning 'ax'.
